question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessions.diagnose`, `openclaw sessions diagnose`, and the proposed result vocabulary as supported core operator/client API in this PR?
rationale: The code path is coherent and well-proven, but adding a durable Gateway/CLI/protocol surface is a product/API commitment that automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept The Diagnosis API
options.body: Land the read-only Gateway RPC, CLI command, Swift model, docs, and result vocabulary as the canonical core operator diagnosis surface.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Trim fields, finding codes, or CLI behavior now if maintainers want a smaller supported compatibility contract.

options.title: Pause Or Close Direction
options.body: Pause this PR and continue discussion on the linked feature issue if core should not own this diagnosis API yet.

recommendation.title: Accept The Diagnosis API
recommendation.body: Land the read-only Gateway RPC, CLI command, Swift model, docs, and result vocabulary as the canonical core operator diagnosis surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest visible history across adjacent Gateway session, protocol, and diagnostic-state surfaces among the inspected candidates.
